title: Pais on Theory of Everything: plasma as doorway

tellings.quote: what Dr. In my opinion, not to speak for him, but that's what Dr. Pye spoke about when he was on Curt Jaimungal's Theory of Everything when he said that it's possible that you can induce these types of effects like inertial mass reduction and so on. Not with solids, but with plasmas

plain: Effects such as reducing an object's mass and its resistance to motion might be produced not with solid materials but with plasmas, the electrically charged gas found in lightning and stars. An engineer named Dave Rossi says this is what Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist known for unusual patents, meant when he appeared on Theory of Everything, a physics podcast hosted by Curt Jaimungal. Rossi offers it as his own reading of Pais, "not to speak for him", and if right it would point to how advanced craft could move as they are said to.
